texts.value: Component of the epidermal cornified cell envelopes
Found in keratohyalin granules in the granular cells of the epidermis
Expressed in cornified epidermis, psoriatic and regenerating skin after wounding. Found in the upper granular layer and in the entire cornified layer of epidermis
Processed during the process of epidermal differentiation
Forms covalent cross-links mediated by transglutaminase TGM3, between glutamine and the epsilon-amino group of lysine residues (in vitro)
Belongs to the S100-fused protein family
In the N-terminal section; belongs to the S-100 family
